faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 1 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Listeners share their best coincidence stories, from random parachuting toys to dollar…
kurzfassung: The show explores true stories of bizarre coincidences sent in by listeners. Participants share tales involving unexpected reunions, strange objects, and uncanny timing. The hosts examine whether these events carry deeper meaning or are simply the product of probability.
stichpunkte: Listeners submitted over 1,300 personal coincidence stories for the episode.
Two high school friends found a toy parachute years apart in entirely different cities.
A grandfather's past girlfriend unexpectedly showed up in family photo albums decades later.
A man discovered a dollar bill inscribed with the name of the woman he later married.
College students independently experienced the bizarre phenomenon of loose coins sticking to their backs.
A teenager spotted a missing mannequin down a manhole after mistaking it for a real person.
A woman encountered her estranged father on top of a remote pyramid in Mexico on Father's Day.

clips.hook: A toy parachute falling from the sky years later
clips.text: Four years after dropping small plastic toy soldiers from the Space Needle, two friends sitting in a hotel room in Nevada witnessed one of the exact same toys land on their windowsill.

clips.hook: Spotting a grandmother in an old childhood photo
clips.text: While looking at a digital photo sent by a friend to update a phone background, a man noticed his own grandmother walking in the background of a picture taken eighteen years prior in a different country.

clips.hook: The marriage proposal via a marked dollar bill
clips.text: Years after getting engaged, a woman revealed that she had previously written her name on multiple dollar bills as a young cashier, hoping the recipient would eventually propose to her.

clips.hook: Coins mysteriously sticking to college students
clips.text: A college student realized that sleeping shirtless on loose change caused coins to impress into his sweaty back, taking several minutes in the shower to finally dislodge.

clips.hook: Encountering an estranged father on a remote pyramid
clips.text: While visiting an off-the-beaten-path national park in Mexico with his mother on Father's Day, an eighteen-year-old literally bumped into his absent father on top of an ancient structure.

beschreibung:
We asked listeners to send us their best coincidence stories, and we got more than 1,300 submissions! There were so many good ones that we decided to make a whole show about them. From a chance encounter at a bus station to a romantic dollar bill to a baffling apparition in a college shower stall.

Start a Life Partners free trial to watch our new video, A Night of Stories and Improv.
(00:00:00) Prologue: Hannah Jacoby tells the story of when she and her best friend Lindsey bonded over those toy soldiers with the parachutes, called (really) Poopatroopers — and how the little jumpers perfectly bookended their high-school years. And guest host Sarah Koenig explains the very interesting trends we discovered in our listeners' coincidences. (9 minutes)
(00:09:23) Act One: A surprising number of coincidences involve grandmothers. One grandma has so many coincidences happen to her that it drives her granddaughter, 16-year-old Juliana Bontrager, to try to beat her at her own coincidence game. We also hear from Blake Oliver about a very strange appearance his grandma once made. (9 minutes)
(00:19:31) Act Two: When it comes to love, coincidences tend to loom extra-large. Stephen Lee tells about the time his parents first met his fiance’s parents, and his future mother-in-law dropped a coincidence bomb. And we hear how a dollar bill ended up clinching a marriage, after floating around Chicago for years. (10 minutes)
(00:28:22) Act Three: Ryan Rozar told us about a confounding coincidence that was visited on him in college. We didn’t think it was a coincidence at all, so we set out to prove him wrong. (8 minutes)
(00:37:39) Act Four: More stories of dazzling coincidences: an old boyfriend is conjured in Morocco, a jazz singer seems to rise from the dead, and three boys believe they’ve seen a corpse. Plus stories of errant fathers, lost and found. (13 minutes)
(00:49:57) Act Five: Kerry Weeks tells about the time he lost a pocketknife and turned to the galaxy for help. (7 minutes)
